paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Ето описанието на дадената научна линейна диаграма:

Диаграмата илюстрира промени в стойностите на коефициента на рядкост в зависимост от слоевете, сравнявайки три конфигурации на затваряне. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и представлява линейна скала, простираща се от 0 до 20. Етикетите на оста са равномерно разпределени с интервал от 1. Оста Y е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio" и също представлява линейна скала, простираща се от 0 до 1.0.

Първата линия, изобразена в син пунктиран стил, е обозначена като "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03".  Тя започва на приблизително 0.2 при слой 0 и намалява стабилно до близо 0 при слой 5, след което остава плоска до слой 20. Втората линия, изобразена в оранжев пунктиран стил, е обозначена като "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44". Започва от 1.0 при слой 0 и намалява рязко, доближавайки се до 0.15 при слой 10, след което и двете линии се стабилизират. Третата линия, изобразена в зелен прекъснат стил, е обозначена като "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". Стабилно поддържа по-висок коефициент на рядкост от оранжевата линия след първоначалния спад, като двете линии не се пресичат след слой 5.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表显示了 SDPA 输出的稀疏率随图层变化的比较，在 1e-2 阈值下，比较了三种门控配置。x 轴标记为“图层”，其刻度类型为线性，数值范围为 0 到 20，均匀的刻度间隔为 1。y 轴标记为“稀疏率比”，其刻度类型为线性，数值范围从 0 到 1。一条蓝色的虚线表示“门控前稀疏率”，从 0.2 开始，稳步下降到图层 5 附近的零，之后保持平稳。一条橙色的点线表示“门控后稀疏率比”，从 1.0 开始，急剧下降并与“平均门控后”线在图层 10 附近汇聚，至 0.15 左右，之后趋于稳定。一条绿色的虚线表示“平均门控后稀疏率比”，从 0.33 开始，在所有图层上持续保持比“门控后”线更高的稀疏度，在图层 5 之后两线不交。
model_annotations.English:
Here's a paragraph describing the plot, following the requested guidelines:

The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across a range of layers, comparing three different gating configurations. The x-axis is labelled "Layer" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labelled "Sparsity Ratio" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.0. A blue dashed line represents the "sparsity ratio before gate" and begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, declining steadily to near zero by layer 5, where it remains relatively flat. An orange dotted line, representing the "sparsity ratio after gate," begins at 1.0 and decreases sharply to approximately 0.15 by layer 10 before stabilizing. A green dash-dot line, representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate," starts at approximately 0.8 and declines to approximately 0.18 by layer 20.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm vergleicht die Sparsity-Ratio des SDPA-Ausgangs über mehrere Schichten hinweg. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und beschriftet mit "Layer", wobei der Wertebereich von 0 bis 20 reicht. Die Tick-Beschriftungen sind numerisch und regelmäßig und verlaufen in 5er-Schritten. Die y-Achse ist linear skaliert und beschriftet mit "Sparsity Ratio", wobei der Wertebereich von 0 bis 1 reicht. Eine Sparsity-Ratio vor dem Gate (blaue gestrichelte Linie) beginnt bei etwa 0.2 bei Layer 0 und nimmt stetig ab, bis sie bei Layer 5 nahe Null liegt, und bleibt danach flach. Die Sparsity-Ratio nach dem Gate (orange gepunktete Linie) beginnt bei 1.0 und nimmt scharf ab, wobei sie sich in der Nähe von Layer 10 mit der Linie nach dem durchschnittlichen Gate bei etwa 0.15 vereint, bevor beide sich stabilisieren. Die Konfiguration nach dem durchschnittlichen Gate (grüne gestrichelte Linie) behält durchgehend eine höhere Sparsity als die Linie nach dem Gate über alle Schichten nach dem anfänglichen Rückgang und die beiden Linien nach Layer 5 nicht mehr schneiden.
